snippet.title: Elements Destiny Release Window Announcement
snippet.description:
Fans of 2D retro-inspired fantasy RPGs, you have a reason to celebrate! Deck13 Spotlight and developer ShrooMoon are thrilled to open the vast world of Solitas before you later this year. You can expect turn-based combat, immersive soundtrack, more than 70 hours of gameplay with an emotional, deep story and high-quality hand-drawn artwork. Wishlist now!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1635500/Elements_Destiny/

X: https://x.com/GameEDofficial

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/elementsdestiny/
